ML Ops Digest
Data Curation
Training data is filtered for personally identifiable information before indexing. Deduplication removes near-duplicate passages, and annotation disputes are resolved through adjudication before the final dataset is frozen.

ML Ops Digest
Evaluation Metrics
Retrieval quality is tracked with recall at 5, mean reciprocal rank, and grounded answer accuracy. Latency is monitored separately so that ranking changes can be compared without conflating speed and relevance.

ML Ops Digest
Deployment Guardrails
Production responses are sampled every week for manual audit. High-risk prompts trigger a human review queue, and model rollouts use staged traffic ramps with rollback thresholds.
